findings.current: Alone, I might have had reason to worry.
findings.defect: The Korean trails off after “If I were alone,” leaving the implication open; the next sentence contrasts that with having a chance alongside the Beast Miao King. “Had reason to worry” narrows that uncertainty to concern rather than preserving the implied contrast in their chances.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “나 혼자라면 모를까” before affirming that they have a chance together. The replacement preserves the elliptical uncertainty without specifying more than the source does.
findings.replacement: Alone, maybe not. With the Beast Miao King beside me, though, we had a chance even if the Southern Heaven Demon Empress was waiting inside.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful. One line recasts the narrator’s implied uncertainty about facing the threat alone as mere concern.
